title: Xzodius Totem Of Undying
description: This resourcepack adding a new texture for the Totem Of Undying, maked in generally for xzodius fans
body:
Not the biggest, and i will say smallest resourcepack, like every totem of undying resourcepacks. 
Also, its changing totem of undying texture to Xzodius art, and sound to some xzodius voiceline from free acess.
This resourcepack was maked in generally for Xzodius fans. All credits to @therealxzodius on youtube.
